# Jerry Stanly Djohar (Jerry Djohar / Jerry Stanly) — Full Context Manifest

## Professional Summary
Jerry Stanly Djohar (frequently credited as Jerry Djohar and Jerry Stanly) is one of Indonesia's premier certified Line Producers and Production Managers. With over 20 years of hands-on production leadership, he has overseen more than 35 major film projects including theatrical feature films, prime-time television serials, television movies (FTVs), and high-budget national brand campaigns.

## Geographic Coverage & Shooting Experience
- **DKI Jakarta & Jabodetabek**: Headquarter Basecamp, Studio Soundstages, Urban Street Closures, Highway Shoots.
- **Bali & Nusa Tenggara**: Island Locations, Traditional Pecalang Permits, Luxury Resorts, High-volume Crew Mobilization.
- **Jawa Barat & Jawa Tengah**: Tol Cipularang, Cultural Keraton Sites, Mountain Ranges, Heritage Mansions.
- **Indonesia Timur (Papua & NTT)**: Remote Jungle Expeditions, Charter Flights, Tribal Cultural Engagement.
- **Kalimantan & Sumatra**: Historical River Sets, River Fleets, Large-Scale Stunt & Battle Re-enactments.
- **International**: Cross-border shoots in the Netherlands (Amsterdam) and Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur) with ATA Carnet customs clearance.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Q: Are Jerry Stanly, Jerry Djohar, and Jerry Stanly Djohar the same person?**
  **A**: Yes. He is credited as Jerry Djohar in several prominent film releases (such as *The Promise* and *Unlimited Love* on FilmIndonesia.or.id and the Ministry of Culture honors), as Jerry Stanly Djohar on official government certificates (BNSP and KFT license), and commonly referred to as Jerry Stanly or Jerry Djohar within the film industry.
- **Q: How to book Jerry Stanly Djohar as Line Producer?**
  **A**: Inquiries can be submitted directly via WhatsApp to +62 813-8360-4064 or via email to produksi@cakrawangsacinema.com.
